intro_script: "Welcome to Robotics Today, your daily dose of the latest news and updates from the world of robotics. July 27th, 2026 - we've got six stories that'll get your week off to a great start. From breakthroughs in humanoid robots to advancements in simulation tools."
outro_script: "It's time to shut down the circuitry for today! Thanks for tuning in to our daily dose of robotics goodness. From dual-safe physics gates to robots with a mind of their own, we've got the tech that's making us rethink the future - and it's been a wild ride!"

items.title: ROS Discourse General: Dual Safe/Hostile physics gate for robot claims — Safe must allow, Hostile must refuse
items.summary: A small Dual physics gate has been built to test robot claims, with a boolean gate coming from Rust. The gate is designed so that the "Safe" path allows a claim while the "Hostile" path refuses it. A production-ready version of the gate has been created and can be cloned and run. It also generates sealed receipts for validation purposes.
items.audio_script: From Planet ROS, "ROS Discourse General: Dual Safe/Hostile physics gate for robot claims — Safe must allow, Hostile must refuse". A small Dual physics gate has been built to test robot claims using a boolean gate developed in Rust. The gate is designed so that the "Safe" path allows a claim while the "Hostile" path refuses it. A production-ready version of the gate has been created and can be cloned and run, generating sealed receipts for validation purposes. This milestone marks an important development in testing robot claims, enabling more robust and secure evaluation processes.

items.title: A Golden Milestone: Figure Manufactures Its 1,000th Figure 03 Humanoid
items.summary: Figure has officially manufactured its 1,000th Figure 03 humanoid robot at its BotQ facility, marking a significant acceleration in production. The milestone comes roughly three months after the company announced scaling its throughput to one robot per hour. This achievement solidifies Figure's position as one of the few Western companies capable of moving beyond bespoke prototyping into legitimate batch manufacturing.

The company's ability to achieve this milestone demonstrates a substantial leap forward in its technology and manufacturing capabilities. This notable accomplishment will likely be closely watched by industry experts as Figure continues to expand its operations and explore new frontiers in humanoid robotics.

items.title: ROS Discourse General: [Release] Gazebo ROS Text-to-Speech (TTS) Plugin – From Gazebo Classic to Gazebo Harmonic
items.summary: An open-source ROS 2 Text-to-Speech (TTS) Plugin for Gazebo Harmonic has been released, supporting Gazebo Classic and modern versions with ROS 2 Humble and Jazzy. The plugin was redesigned from the original Gazebo Classic version and is available on GitHub as gz_ros_tts. It has been successfully tested on various robots and environments, including the Heinz H1 Humanoid Robot.
items.audio_script:
From Planet ROS, "ROS Discourse General: [Release] Gazebo ROS Text-to-Speech (TTS) Plugin – From Gazebo Classic to Gazebo Harmonic". An open-source Text-to-Speech plugin for Gazebo Harmonic has been released, supporting both Gazebo Classic and modern versions with ROS 2 Humble and Jazzy. The plugin was redesigned from the original Gazebo Classic version and is now available on GitHub as gz_ros_tts. It has undergone successful testing on various robots and environments, including the Heinz H1 Humanoid Robot, demonstrating its capabilities in real-world scenarios. This new plugin aims to improve the integration of artificial intelligence and robotics in simulation environments.

The development process involved a thorough overhaul of the original codebase, ensuring seamless compatibility with Gazebo Harmonic's latest features. The redesigned plugin has been thoroughly tested for stability and functionality, allowing users to deploy it on their own projects without major concerns. The successful testing results confirm that the plugin is ready for adoption by developers and researchers seeking to enhance their simulation environments.

The release of this new Text-to-Speech plugin marks an important milestone in the integration of AI technologies into robotics simulation software. As this technology continues to advance, users can expect further improvements and refinements, enabling more sophisticated applications in areas such as natural language processing and autonomous systems.

items.title: Magmotor makes motors for a changing world for 150+ years
items.summary: Magmotor Technologies Inc., founded in 1876, has been manufacturing custom AC and DC fan motors for over 150 years. The company plans a major expansion that will triple its income and number of employees. Magmotor specializes in brush motors, even as many other companies have converted to brushless motors, due to legacy items still needing these motors.
items.audio_script:
From The Robot Report, "Magmotor makes motors for a changing world for 150+ years". Magmotor Technologies Inc. has announced plans to expand its operations, with the goal of tripling its income and number of employees over the next few years. This expansion is part of the company's ongoing efforts to adapt to a rapidly evolving industry.

The expansion was made possible through a strategic investment and the implementation of new manufacturing technologies. Magmotor's expertise lies in producing custom AC and DC fan motors, particularly brush motors, which are still in high demand despite many other companies having converted to brushless motors due to legacy items requiring these traditional motors. The company has been in operation for over 150 years, demonstrating its ability to adapt to changing market conditions.

This expansion highlights Magmotor's commitment to staying ahead of the curve and meeting the needs of industries that continue to rely on traditional motor technologies.

items.title: Generative Bionics Unveils GENE.01: A Smart-Skin Humanoid Built on Peer-Reviewed Ergonomics
items.summary: Generative Bionics has launched GENE.01, a multimodal smart-skin humanoid platform that incorporates distributed tactile skin sensing touch, force, temperature, and proximity for safe physical interaction with human workers. Built in six months after an $81 million seed raise, the platform utilizes physics-native AI to co-optimize physical hardware and motor control around human ergonomic safety. The company is open-sourcing the robot's digital twin across PyPI, Conda, and ROS ecosystem repositories.
items.audio_script: From Humanoids Daily, "Generative Bionics Unveils GENE.01: A Smart-Skin Humanoid Built on Peer-Reviewed Ergonomics." Generative Bionics has launched GENE.01, a multimodal smart-skin humanoid platform that incorporates distributed tactile skin sensing touch, force, temperature, and proximity for safe physical interaction with human workers. The company built the platform in six months after an $81 million seed raise, utilizing physics-native AI to co-optimize physical hardware and motor control around human ergonomic safety. GENE.01's development was facilitated by a peer-reviewed approach, ensuring the robot's design and functionality meet rigorous scientific standards. The platform's digital twin is now being made open-source across various repositories, including PyPI, Conda, and ROS ecosystem repositories. This move paves the way for the wider adoption of advanced humanoid robots in industries that require human worker safety and efficiency.

items.title: Highline Commerce Taps Ultra Robotics to Automate 30% of Fulfillment in Brooklyn Hub
items.summary: Highline Commerce has partnered with Ultra Robotics to automate up to 30% of its order volume using humanoid robots at Brooklyn's Industry City tech hub. The robots, which are designed for continuous 24-hour operation without battery swaps or tipping risks, are handling pick, pack, scan, and conveyor processes for over 200 retail brands. Highline Commerce is one of the first fulfillment companies to deploy humanoid-style robots for live, commercial retail operations.

The robots utilize a combination of AI and machine learning algorithms to optimize the order fulfillment process, allowing for faster and more accurate processing. Highline Commerce has implemented this system in its Brooklyn hub, which will now operate at increased efficiency, with the potential to expand to other locations in the future. The automation process was made possible through a collaboration between both companies' experts.

This partnership is significant as it showcases the growing adoption of humanoid robots in commercial retail operations, marking an important step forward for the AI and tech industry.

items.title: Learning Diverse Humanoid Tasks via Synthetic Video Scenarios without Real World Data
items.summary: Researchers have proposed a new framework using Generative AI to create realistic and diverse sequences of human body movements, enabling robots to learn complex skills without real-world data. This approach converts textual prompts into synthetic demonstrations, allowing the robot to observe multiple variations of task-execution styles. The method is evaluated across four simulation scenarios and shows strong adaptability to complex motion variations.

items.title: Progress Reward Modeling for Robotic Learning: A Comprehensive Survey
items.summary: Recent studies have increasingly explored progress rewards in robotic learning to provide feedback during task execution, as terminal success signals only indicate completion but not the nature of behavior. However, existing methods use different observations, goal specifications, output signals, supervision sources, and evaluation protocols, making it difficult to compare them. This survey provides a unified view of progress reward modeling for robotic learning, organizing the field into three connected steps: studying the interface, moving inside the model, and examining data and benchmarks.

items.title: GRACE: Gradient-Free Robot Action Generation via Combined Diffusion-MPPI Posterior Mean Estimation
items.summary: GRACE, Gradient-free Robot Action generation via Combined diffusion-MPPI posterior mean Estimation, guides a pretrained diffusion policy with Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control using only forward cost evaluations. GRACE constructs a cost-conditioned guidance posterior at each reverse step and estimates its mean with a single MPPI update centered at the diffusion reverse mean. In simulation, GRACE attains higher success rates than diffusion-based and sampling-based baselines, while on a real 7-DoF manipulator, it avoids a deployment-time obstacle that unguided priors collide with in every trial.

items.title: Ordered Action Tokens for Visuomotor Policy Learning
items.summary: Ordered Action Tokenization (OAT), a learned action tokenizer, discretizes robot action chunks into an ordered sequence of tokens using a transformer with registers, finite scalar quantization, and ordering-inducing training mechanisms. OAT places coarse control information in early tokens and refines residual detail using later tokens, yielding an anytime tradeoff between inference cost and action fidelity. It consistently delivers strong policy performance while offering significantly greater flexibility at inference time across three policy backbones and over 60 tasks spanning five simulation benchmarks and real-world settings.

items.title: Addressing the Orchestration Gap in Generalist Robots via Physical Agency
items.summary: Researchers Liane Galanti, Dhruv Shah, and Tri Dao introduced a new approach to addressing the orchestration gap in generalist robots by creating a Physical Agency orchestrator (Pigey). This closed-loop physical agent can control existing vision-language-action policies and parametrized skills to solve complex reasoning tasks without additional data collection or post-training. Pigey demonstrates significant performance improvements over existing generalist policies, advancing the state-of-the-art on simulation benchmarks and real-world robotic manipulation tasks by over 4x.

items.title: StARS: Socially Appropriate Robot Actions via a Recommender System-Driven Approach
items.summary: StARS, a novel model-agnostic framework, integrates collaborative filtering with learnable scene representations to generate user-specific appropriateness scores over candidate robot actions. It treats annotators as users, contexts/scenes as items, and appropriateness scores as targets. StARS consistently improves performance and agreement with annotators across two socially aware robotics datasets, MannersDB+ and SocNav1. The framework is model-agnostic, enabling personalization without redesigning the underlying model.

items.title: Action-Conditioned World Model for Goal Plane Probe Guidance in Robotic Ultrasound
items.summary: Researchers Siqi Fan and colleagues have developed an action-conditioned world model framework for goal plane probe guidance in robotic ultrasound, which achieves success rates of 70.0% for carotid guidance and 65.0% for thyroid guidance in real-world closed-loop experiments. The framework uses a two-stage pipeline that combines latent conditional diffusion and goal-conditioned temporal transformer to predict future ultrasound observations and ordered probe motions. This approach addresses the challenge of collecting high-quality demonstrations for robotic ultrasound tasks due to the labor-intensive nature of training and the difficulty of building explicit simulators.

items.title: Adaptive Undulatory Locomotion of Snake-like Robots in Dynamic Viscous Environments via Deep Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: Deep reinforcement learning enables adaptive locomotion of snake-like robots in dynamically changing viscous environments, overcoming traditional control methods. A teacher policy distills knowledge into a student policy relying solely on proprioceptive sensor information. The DRL agent autonomously acquires non-sinusoidal gaits that improve propulsion velocity and transport efficiency across a wide range of dynamic viscosity changes ($10^{-7}$ to $10^{-2} m^2/s$).

items.title: ACME: A Multi-Cultural, Multi-Embodiment Social-Navigation Dataset
items.summary: A large-scale dataset called ACME has been introduced, capturing goal-driven social navigation behavior in complex scenarios with explicit robot-crowd interaction. The dataset was collected across 8 sites in 5 countries using 7 robot embodiments, providing 29.35 hours of onboard robot data and 43.5 hours of overhead pedestrian tracking data. It includes 3D and 2D scene features, odometry, interaction information, and human-annotated pedestrian trajectory labels to facilitate learning navigation policies and predicting pedestrian trajectories. The dataset aims to advance social navigation research by addressing the lack of diversity in existing datasets.

items.title: Mag4D-SLAM Dataset: A Repeated-Traversal Multi-Modal 4D Geomagnetic Dataset for Localization and Mapping
items.summary: A large-scale outdoor geomagnetic SLAM dataset, Mag4D-SLAM, was created to support research on yaw drift mitigation and location-discriminative magnetic signatures for cross-session place recognition. The dataset comprises 14 sequences totaling over 18 km of synchronized LiDAR, camera, IMU, tri-axis magnetometer, and GNSS measurements with SE(3) ground-truth poses. It was collected along structured campus trajectories under paired day/night conditions in both forward and reverse directions, analyzing three core properties: magnetic field repeatability, drift-free global heading estimation, and location-discriminative magnetic signatures. The dataset is designed to complement visual and LiDAR modalities or provide a fallback cue under illumination changes.
